hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.kt) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; jar=$(find "$HOME/.gradle/caches/modules-2/files-2.1/com.facebook/ktfmt" -name "ktfmt-*-with-dependencies.jar" 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); [ -n "$jar" ] || exit 0; java -jar "$jar" --google-style "$f"; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; c=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD -- "*.kt" "*.kts"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "*.kt" "*.kts"; } 2>/dev/null ); [ -n "$c" ] || exit 0; n=$(printf "%s\n" "$c" | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d " "); printf "{\"systemMessage\":\"%s Kotlin file(s) changed - run /verify (ktfmtFormat, sortDependencies, detektAll, :module:build) before committing.\",\"suppressOutput\":true}\n" "$n"
